research_disposition: Source-backed extension of the existing document/contract-test seam. Native Claude OTel logs -> existing collector -> Loki capture emitted terminal records only; complete retry accounting and TTL weighting are unqualified. ccusage v20.0.26 is a cross-check, and Inspect 0.3.271 exact matching uses independent predicate records. No inspect_swe bridge. Prior repair reported installed Inspect 0.3.266; current repair python3 metadata did not find inspect-ai, and no pinned scorer was run. Supported source isolation keeps user-settings and inherited window values out of every arm without editing host settings; the host incumbent is A (key absent) per the dated host-condition amendment. No host changes, Claude sessions, subagents or installations in this repair.

native_lever.precedence: The environment variable overrides /autocompact, --autocompact and autoCompactWindow. --autocompact auto neutralizes only a saved autoCompactWindow; it cannot erase a settings env entry. --settings merges omitted keys from enabled lower scopes, so omission is not deletion.
native_lever.workflow_inheritance: Not established by an explicit guarantee for this variable in the inspected primary sources. Subagents share main-conversation compaction logic; applying the session environment to Workflow children is an inference that requires native treatment evidence.
native_lever.per_agent_control: Not found in installed 2.1.283 --help, the changelog through v2.1.283, or the inspected Workflow/subagent configuration documentation. This is a scoped search finding, not a claim that an undocumented API cannot exist.
native_lever.process_isolation: One new headless coordinator process per task/arm/repetition. Do not change the variable inside a coordinator or put multiple treatments in sibling children.

treatment_proof.configuration: Apply arm_readback_gate for every task/arm/repetition. Retain selected user/launch/coordinator/child values or unset markers, loaded-source/common-packet digests and client version only. Do not infer A from --autocompact auto or the repair-builder shell; effective child evidence and native compaction/context checks are separate gates.
treatment_proof.sdk_event: SDK streams use compact_metadata.trigger and compact_metadata.pre_tokens; do not parse them as native JSONL fields or count both copies.
treatment_proof.context_measure: Per deduplicated assistant request, prompt_tokens = input_tokens + cache_creation_input_tokens + cache_read_input_tokens. Record maximum and the last prompt before/first after each boundary. Never substitute cumulative cache reads for context size.
treatment_proof.B_and_C: Every focal child must have at least one automatic boundary. Every automatic preTokens value must lie in its arm's partition band (validity_bands): B [330300, 870300), C [150300, 330300). Each lower bound is 0.9 x the arm's expected automatic trigger (window - 33000, observed on 2.1.283); each upper bound is the next-higher arm's lower bound, exclusive. These are experimental validity bands, not an upstream timing guarantee. Outside-band or missing evidence makes the run incomplete; do not widen bands after observing results.
treatment_proof.A: Every focal child must exceed 400000 prompt tokens. If it auto-compacts, preTokens must be in 870300..1000000 inclusive (approximately 967000 = 1000000 - 33000; lower bound 0.9 x that trigger, upper bound the model's 1000000-token window; unchanged by the 2026-09-27 host-condition amendment). If it never compacts, retain that right-censored observation and the verified default launch; do not invent an event at 967000.
treatment_proof.exclusions: Any manual compaction, context-limit recovery compaction, continuation as a replacement child, unresolved fallback, or context cap invalidates the matched comparison, with usage retained. Native automatic compaction in the same child is the treatment.

validity_bands.lower_bound: 0.9 x the arm's expected automatic trigger, inclusive; this keeps the 10% tolerance below the trigger.
validity_bands.upper_bound: The next-higher arm's lower bound, exclusive; A's upper bound is the model's 1000000-token window, inclusive.
validity_bands.attribution: Every automatic preTokens value stays attributable to exactly one arm's trigger. A misapplied default window (an event at or above 870300) or a lower window (an event below 0.9 x the trigger) still invalidates the run; normal last-request overshoot above the trigger does not.
validity_bands.scope: Experiment validity rule, not an upstream guarantee of when compaction fires.
validity_bands.client_change_rule: The expected triggers use the 33000-token autocompact buffer displayed by client 2.1.283. A client version change can move the buffer and needs a dated amendment before launch.
validity_bands.superseded_reason: Inclusive +/-10% bands centred on each window value rather than on its trigger. The old C band 180000..220000 excluded C's nominal ~167000 trigger, so a C focal child compacting near its trigger would have been out of band and invalidated the run; an overshoot into the band, such as 190000, would have met it. B's 367000 lay only 7000 inside 360000..440000. Replaced before any cohort or model observation.
validity_bands.considered_rejection_reason: Symmetric inclusive +/-10% bands around each trigger were the first draft of this amendment. The relayed native event at 432724 in a 400000-window session (+17.9% over 367000, about 1 in 31 such events) falls outside 330300..403700. Focal children can compact more than once, and overshoot is an absolute last-request growth that weighs most on C, so symmetric bands would spuriously invalidate many runs. Replaced by the partition rule before commit.

settings_isolation.mechanism: Supported settings-source isolation for all arms, plus one identical explicit settings packet.
settings_isolation.procedure: Use --setting-sources project --settings <sealed-common-settings.json> for every coordinator. The immutable project settings at the frozen base and the common packet must omit the selected env key. The common packet explicitly supplies the same required non-secret Ultracode, hook, agent, permission and telemetry settings for every arm; qualify their fingerprints rather than assuming excluded user/local features survive. Native authentication remains native; do not copy sign-ins or private state. Managed settings still apply and any managed or embedding-host injection of this key blocks launch.

per_arm_environment.A: Remove the selected key from the launch environment with env -u CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW. This stays required after the 2026-09-27 removal from user settings: sessions started before the removal keep 400000 in their process environment (the coordinator's shell read 400000 at about 23:28Z), and a launcher spawned from such a session would pass it on. Excluding user/local settings keeps any user env entry from being reintroduced. Keep --autocompact auto.
per_arm_environment.B: Set CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW=400000 in the isolated launch environment; keep the common settings packet and --autocompact auto.
per_arm_environment.C: Set CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW=200000 in the isolated launch environment; keep the common settings packet and --autocompact auto.

settings_isolation.unset_support_search: A supported per-key deletion operation for settings env was not found in installed 2.1.283 --help, the v2.1.283 changelog, or the inspected settings/model-config/CLI docs. Do not pass invented unset flags, null, empty string or auto as an env value. Source exclusion is the selected remedy.
settings_isolation.alternative_config_directory: CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR is documented to relocate settings, session history and plugins; it would need separately qualified matching setup and native authentication. It is researched but not selected for this draft. Do not switch to it mid-cohort.
settings_isolation.qualification: Flags were inspected without starting a session; effective source exclusion and Workflow inheritance remain unqualified.

arm_readback_gate.prelaunch_procedure: Before admitting each attempt, read back only the selected user-settings key to confirm the recorded incumbent (A: key absent); inspect the sealed enabled project/explicit/managed sources for that key and capture the launch-environment selected value or explicit unset marker after the arm patch. Read back, value-only, that every must_be_absent_in_every_arm key is absent from the patched launch environment and the enabled settings sources. Confirm common packet/source hashes and --setting-sources project. Any unavailable effective source or conflicting injection fails preflight. No all-environment or credential dump.
arm_readback_gate.runtime_procedure: A separately qualified value-only native shell observation in the launched coordinator and each focal child must read the selected environment key after settings application and corroborate loaded settings-source identity. No documented dry-run/effective-window readback CLI is claimed. A prelaunch file read alone cannot prove child inheritance; until this observation path is qualified, do not launch. During eventual sealed attempts, count any readiness usage and abort on mismatch before accepting treatment; native automatic-boundary/context evidence remains separately required.

The env-vars docs (read 2026-09-27): 'Set the percentage (1-100) of the auto-compact window at which auto-compaction triggers ... the variable can't raise the threshold'; it applies to main conversations and subagents.

The env-vars docs (read 2026-09-27): 'Increasing this value reduces the effective context window available before auto-compaction triggers'. A peer's undocumented implementation reading, not relied on, also ties the reserve to the model's maximum output. Required absent as a precaution.

builder_oracle.source: Pinned child-usage.mjs deduplication/counter conventions and official native_compaction transcript schema. These author-written vectors are synthetic fixtures, not upstream tests.
builder_oracle.contract: compactionSummary(rows) is a pure exported function. Count only native system/compact_boundary rows; auto events retain pre_tokens in order, manual events are counted separately. Compute max prompt tokens from deduplicated assistant messages using the original module's greatest-output rule. Count distinct assistant identities with no usage object as missing. Input rows are not mutated.
builder_oracle.independence: The experiment's accounting and compaction extraction remain the sealed baseline tools plus independent native event inspection. Never use the builder candidate as the instrument measuring its own arm.

execution.reset_rule: Begin readiness immediately after the specified reset; verify actual reset in /usage. A different reset, unsealed draft or unmet gate postpones the run; never silently start another week or run this draft.
execution.schedule_algorithm: For repetition index 0..2, visit task_order_by_repetition[index]; run its three arms in order_by_task[task][index]. Each task occupies each arm-position once; all six permutations occur twice overall. Do not reorder after failures.
execution.washout: Wait at least 360 seconds after the last request and process-group termination before the next attempt, including same-model wrapper work. Verify 5-minute child TTL. No other Claude use during the experiment. Within-child cache reuse stays native; first-request cache read is measured, not assumed zero.
execution.retries: No replacement attempts or human repair within this run. Native provider retries remain part of the original attempt's usage. Ordinary completed task failures remain scored failures; protocol interruptions or restarts stop the whole run as incomplete.
execution.eligibility: All 12 A focal children must exceed 400000 per-request prompt tokens; all 24 B/C focal children must demonstrate automatic compaction in their assigned validity bands. No padding, wider bands, dropping tasks or adding turns after seeing a short/failing run. Preserve all records and stop incomplete on the first violated eligibility condition.

precision.variance_source: No independent pilot variance for paired task costs exists. Max-effort output, tool trajectory, compaction work and cache reuse vary within task; task heterogeneity cannot be treated as independent repeats of one task.
precision.supported_claim: Three repeats give position balance, observed ranges and a descriptive finite-suite ranking only. They do not establish a repeatable 10% saving, statistical quality non-inferiority, 95% confidence or general adoption.
precision.illustrative_precision: For independent approximately normal paired relative cost differences d, a two-sided 95% t interval has half-width t(0.975,n-1)*s_d/sqrt(n). At n=3, t=4.303: half-width is 2.484*s_d. A half-width <=0.10 would require s_d<=0.0403, which is unmeasured. This illustration is not an interval for the failure-inclusive ratio of sums and not a power calculation.
precision.future_design: Use an independent pilot to estimate within-task paired variation and task/check discordance, then preregister a fresh confirmatory cohort and simultaneous inference for both candidates and per-task gates. For mean-difference planning, solve t(0.975,n-1)*s_d/sqrt(n)<=h at the chosen precision h; the actual ratio-per-success needs an appropriate paired ratio/failure model. No numerical confirmatory n is asserted without variance.
precision.stability: Report paired costs, check outcomes and ranges by task/repetition. Recompute the same descriptive decision leaving out each complete repetition block in turn (all tasks/all arms together); a changed ranking or loss of any 10% gate is unstable. This sensitivity check is not a confidence interval and cannot promote a pilot winner to adoption.

quality.source: Inspect 0.3.271 match scorers over canonical independent observed/target records from the eight thin adapter contracts; no model self-reported pass flags.
quality.denominator: Two checks per task attempt, 24 check opportunities and 12 task attempts per arm
quality.success: A task succeeds only when every frozen check passes; report each boolean, pass count and successful-task count. Missing evidence is unknown, never pass.

child_usage.source: Authoritative request_ledger OTel rows attributed to focal/wrapper children; unchanged baseline child-usage.mjs is an independent transcript cross-check only.
child_usage.window: Entire fresh Workflow attempt, first request through final/interrupted record, including every failed, restarted or superseded child attempt
child_usage.denominator: Per attempt, per model, and all assigned attempts per successful task within each arm/task and pooled arm
child_usage.aggregation: Sum the four counters from emitted deduplicated child-attributed api_request IDs once per model. Retain observed compact/background/refusal/fallback and failed/interrupted work, but do not claim intermediate retries are measured. Terminal api_error or any unresolved counter, request ownership or retry coverage makes the pilot incomplete; do not add transcript/ccusage/coordinator or quota totals.

weighted_cost.unit: USD-equivalent at dated public standard API rates, not subscription billing
weighted_cost.formula: W = sum_over_models((p_input*input_tokens + p_write*cache_creation_input_tokens + p_read*cache_read_input_tokens + p_output*output_tokens)/1000000); cost_per_success = sum(W across ALL assigned attempts)/successful_task_count
weighted_cost.normalized_weights: Opus 5.5: 1,1.25,0.05,5. Sonnet 5: 1,1.25,0.1,5. Never sum these differently based normalized units across models; the dollar-equivalent W is the common weighted total.
weighted_cost.zero_successes: Undefined, not zero cost; no candidate adoption if any compared task/arm has zero successes.
weighted_cost.separation: Keep the four token categories separately; thinking is already output. The listed prices and W are conditional on five-minute child cache writes and normal speed. api_request has no cache-write TTL split, so the one-hour exclusion is currently not evaluable. Unknown TTL, model/tier or usage leaves W/CPS unknown and forbids selection. No >200K premium at these rates.

cache_write_ttl_evidence.required_evidence: A source-backed per-request 5-minute/1-hour cache-write breakdown joined to the same provider request_id, with totals equal to cache_creation_tokens, must be qualified by a dated amendment. No claim is made that pinned client transcripts retain this breakdown. Config inspection, aggregate cost estimates and five-minute defaults are not per-request TTL evidence.
cache_write_ttl_evidence.token_budget: Retain the aggregate cache_creation_tokens once in the token budget even when monetary weighting is unknown.

compaction.source: Native per-child compact_boundary records and deduplicated provider prompt counters; sdk_compaction only as a separately identified schema
compaction.denominator: Each event and each child; event count, preTokens, last-before/first-after request prompt tokens, maximum prompt tokens
compaction.missing: No event is a valid censored A observation only with complete transcript; missing transcript/context is unknown.

context_utilization_secondary.source: The same deduplicated request_ledger rows and native compact_boundary records as metrics.compaction, plus the frozen Inspect check outcomes.

reported_per_task_and_arm.check_outcomes: Each frozen check boolean for every repetition, as in metrics.quality.
reported_per_task_and_arm.focal_child_peak_prompt_tokens: Per focal child: the maximum over its deduplicated requests of input_tokens + cache_creation_input_tokens + cache_read_input_tokens.
reported_per_task_and_arm.focal_child_peak_window_utilization: Per focal child: peak prompt tokens divided by 1000000, the model's native window, reported as an exact fraction and a percentage.

context_utilization_secondary.contrast: The existing eligibility rule requires all 12 A focal children to exceed 400000 prompt tokens (40% of the 1M window), while the expected B and C triggers sit at about 36.7% and 16.7%. The arms therefore already contrast utilization above 40% with triggers below it. Last-request overshoot can carry a B child's peak above 40% (the relayed maximum 432724 is 43.3%), so peaks are recorded, not assumed.
context_utilization_secondary.boundary: Three repetitions of four frozen tasks are not powered to satisfy SIZE-07's overturn condition, a local trial correlating utilization above 40% with measurably worse extraction or review quality. This outcome does not enter selection and adds no quality-superiority selection path; decision_rule is unchanged.
context_utilization_secondary.denominator: Each focal child, reported alongside the check outcomes of its task/arm/repetition

wall_time.source: Supervisor monotonic timestamps corroborated by native journal start/end
wall_time.window: Coordinator launch to process-group exit for an attempt; separately child first-to-last record
wall_time.denominator: Seconds per attempt; all-attempt seconds per successful task; total scheduled elapsed also includes washouts
wall_time.failures: Failed/interrupted wall time retained; process liveness is not completion.

weekly_quota.source: Native /usage value-only weekly buckets and reset timestamp, before readiness and after settled final shutdown
weekly_quota.denominator: Percentage points within each unchanged weekly bucket; never aggregate overlapping buckets
weekly_quota.aggregation: Report per-bucket end minus baseline with reading age and reset identity. Missing/stale readings stay unknown. Cached /usage is not the token stop instrument or a conversion to subscription charge.

coordinator.source: Coordinator-owned rows in the same request_ledger; always included in the run token budget, reported separately from child cost.
coordinator.denominator: Per attempt, separately from child cost
coordinator.boundary: Exclude child-inclusive cumulative totals; do not add these observations to overlapping reports. Coordinator cache may last 1 hour. A claim about whole-session quality per token would require a separate matched design.

request_ledger.instrument: Claude Code native OTel api_request events
request_ledger.scope: Registry of owned processes/sessions maps task/arm/repetition and Workflow ownership. Retain every emitted api_request, api_error and api_refusal from launch/readiness through settlement, with coordinator usage separate. This log-only instrument does not observe intermediate retry attempts; complete request coverage is unqualified.
request_ledger.event_name_note: OTel event body/name can be claude_code.api_request while event.name is api_request; qualify the actual Loki mapping before sealing, not a text search of content-omitted bodies.
request_ledger.attribute_scope: required_attributes applies to a metered api_request, which has no documented attempt field. api_error supplies attempt as a terminal chain total and speed but no four-counter usage; api_refusal supplies attempt, speed and server_fallback_hop. request_id may be absent on a failure; workflow.run_id is required for emitted Workflow-owned events. Require applicable fields by event type; absent applicable fields are unknown, never false/zero/normal. agent_id and parent_agent_id are span attributes, not log-ledger join fields.
request_ledger.query: Read GET /loki/api/v1/query_range with a sealed service/session selector, fixed start/end nanoseconds and direction=forward. Poll every 1 second using overlapping ranges from launch through now. Page/split until no response is limit-truncated; retain every page and its query interval. A full page, missing interval or error cannot be a complete ledger. Re-query the whole interval after shutdown/drain.

deduplication.rule: Attach the sealed run provider constant; identical retransmissions of metered events with the same provider/request_id collapse once across overlapping queries/exporter retransmissions. Different provider request IDs count separately. Error/refusal records join only when a matching native request ID exists and add no counters. Missing IDs enter a separate unresolved holding area, never a synthetic usage row.

missing_request_id.collision_policy: Retain each event with its observer envelope ordinal; event.sequence is per-process, so this locator is not a unique provider-request identity. Never merge colliding events or infer zero usage. client_request_id, if present, is a chain correlation only.

request_ledger.join: Join transcript/provider request ID to OTel request_id using the qualified native mapping. Use client_request_id to correlate terminal chain records only; api_request has no attempt attribute. Attribute through session.id, workflow.run_id, query_source and the independently qualified launch registry. Span-only agent_id/parent_agent_id are excluded. Any ambiguous compact/background owner blocks comparison. compact_boundary is treatment evidence, not a usage row.
request_ledger.fallback: Inspect resolved model and api_refusal.server_fallback_hop as well as launch model. Retain fallback usage in the budget, invalidate the matched cost comparison on any fallback, and keep unreported fallback charge unknown. Never filter fallback/error requests out to make totals agree.

reconciliation.scope: Run offline for every owned native session after settled exit. Explicitly map focal/wrapper transcripts and parent session scope; prove whether this pin includes each child before comparing like scopes. The transcript helper supplies a separate child attribution check, not the primary total.
reconciliation.equation: For each session/model/token category: OTel_total = ccusage_total + OTel_only - ccusage_only. Each residual must be enumerated by private request ID and native source, with complete four-category usage. Expected final ccusage_only=0. OTel-only compact/background usage may be legitimate if independently attributed and metered; equal totals alone do not prove coverage.
reconciliation.absence_rule: No usage row is not proof of zero charge. Any terminal api_error ends this pilot incomplete because no admissible counter source is qualified. Refusal/hop records without matched metered request counters, timeouts or cancellations remain unknown; a successful retry chain still lacks intermediate-attempt coverage.

qualification.note: At reviewed HEAD the log keep_keys allowlist drops request_id, client_request_id, server_fallback_hop and speed; it also drops span-only agent_id/parent_agent_id, which are no longer log requirements. It retains workflow.run_id, query_source, attempt, model and all four counters. Active collector/Loki readback is unobserved; do not modify the collector in this repair.
qualification.procedure: Before sealing, qualify every required_log_attributes field emitted by each applicable event type through the active collector into Loki, retaining sanitized native-to-Loki equality observations and type/value checks. Exercise fallback-hop and fast/normal discriminating observations from permitted retained evidence; a preserved-ID-only check is insufficient. Template membership alone is not active preservation or source emission. Reject missing applicable attributes and unresolved child joins; no body or trace fallback is silently assumed.

run_constants.provenance: Sealed once per run from shared_controls.provider: native Anthropic API route, not a captured api_request attribute. Attach this constant to each ledger row; any route drift invalidates comparison.

retry_observability.successful_chain_limitation: An api_request is a successful terminal event; it does not enumerate earlier attempts or establish that no retries occurred. gen_ai.request.attempt belongs to traces, which this ledger does not collect. A later success or matching ccusage sum cannot establish zero intermediate charge.
retry_observability.future_resolution: A separately sourced and qualified complete attempt/counter instrument needs a dated amendment before any launch. Adding trace identifiers alone would not establish token counters; none is implemented or qualified in this repair.

decision_rule.quality_rule: For every task and check, any pass in A requires a pass in every repetition of the candidate.
decision_rule.pass_count_rule: Candidate total passed checks and successful tasks must each be at least A's totals.
decision_rule.cost_rule: All-attempt weighted child cost per successful task must be at least 10% lower than A, both pooled and for each task.
decision_rule.selection_rule: Among quality-eligible candidates meeting the 10% pooled and per-task cost margin versus A, choose the unique lowest pooled all-attempt weighted child cost per successful task; an exact cost tie yields no selection and leaves the incumbent host setting A unchanged.
decision_rule.incomplete_rule: Any stopped, invalid, underlength, or unmeasured run is incomplete; no adoption result.
decision_rule.completeness_gate: All 36 prescribed attempts and their independent check results, usage and treatment evidence are available, with every eligibility/control/seal gate passed. Completed ordinary task failures count; no imputation or best-of repetitions.
decision_rule.cost_test: For each candidate independently (no arm order): for each task and the pool require successes(A)>0, successes(X)>0 and CPS(X)<=0.90*CPS(A). Among qualifying quality-non-inferior candidates minimize pooled CPS. Use exact decimal/rational rates and unrounded token totals. No additional effect threshold between B and C; equal minima give no selection, not a larger-cost winner.
decision_rule.interpretation: An exploratory finite frozen-suite ranking only. The quality rules operationalize observed non-inferiority, not a statistical confidence bound. Three repetitions and the 10% observed margin do not support persistent adoption or generalization; future confirmation requires an independently preregistered cohort. Equal task relevance is protected by the per-task margin; pooled cost is the explicit ranking objective.
overturn_conditions: A matched frozen check regresses after adoption
A repeat with the same sealed inputs loses the 10% cost margin
A client/model/compaction-policy/TTL/token-lane change invalidates the treatment or weights
An independent accounting audit finds missing, duplicated, fallback or misattributed usage
A larger independently sealed real-task suite contradicts the result
decision_rule.reopen_evidence: A dated amendment with pinned changed inputs/reason and a new complete counterbalanced cohort, independent oracle evidence, native treatment/usage records and all previous failed/stopped attempts. Anecdotes, source claims or selectively rerun winners cannot reopen adoption.
decision_rule.worked_example_scope: Every task has these CPS values and all gates hold. Selected is a descriptive pilot nomination only; null means no nomination and leaves incumbent A (key absent, native default) unchanged. A is both the host incumbent and the isolated default reference arm. No nomination changes a host setting.

other_stops: Wrong actual worktree base or forbidden file edit
Unproven Workflow treatment, manual compaction, missing boundary, out-of-band compaction or underlength A child
Unsafe or non-offline fixture/check dependency discovered
Any interrupted coordinator/child, transcript gap or unscheduled restart
stop_rules.reporting: Retain failed and interrupted attempts, all known usage, unknown fields as null, native error category, cap/termination reason and incomplete status. A stopped run never selects a window. No retry in another weekly window without an append-only amendment and new cohort.

token_budget.rationale: A fixed proposed resource ceiling for this draft, not a conversion of the former weekly-percent allowance, billing guarantee or evidence that the 36 attempts fit. It includes cache reads once, unlike a monetary budget.
token_budget.observed_tokens: Sum all four native categories once over emitted deduplicated request_ledger rows. Required budget scope includes coordinators, children, preparation, compaction, wrappers, all retries/failures/refusals/fallbacks and interruptions, but current logs cannot prove intermediate-retry coverage. Unobserved counters remain unknown and prohibit launch/selection; never claim scope inclusion is instrument coverage.
token_budget.admission: Before every launch require observed_tokens + outstanding_reserve_tokens < limit_tokens and a healthy qualified observer. Stop scheduling at the first trigger. Readiness/model requests, if later authorized, use this same budget; no unmetered calibration probes.

reporting_lag.procedure: For retained permitted native request receipts, join provider completion/OTel event time to first query-visible Loki arrival while polling every P=1 second on a synchronized clock; record query errors, clock uncertainty, min/p50/p95/max and sample count, including compact/error/refusal paths. First query visibility gives an upper sample lag after adding clock uncertainty; event.timestamp is not ingest time. Do not read prompt bodies.
reporting_lag.interpretation: The documented default log export interval is not a measured reporting lag or a worst-case delivery bound. Observed maxima/percentiles cannot establish a deterministic future L_bound; native export retries can delay delivery.

variables.R_max: Proven maximum total of all four token categories for one accepted provider request across all permitted resolved models, including compaction/fallback; cache categories partition input, not duplicate it.
variables.N_active_max: Enforced maximum simultaneous uncompleted requests in all owned coordinator/child/background/retry paths, not merely the number of focal children.
variables.lambda_max: Enforced upper request-completion rate per second with bursts covered by N_active_max; an observed mean/max is insufficient.
variables.L_bound: Enforced upper time from request completion to observer visibility, including exporter queue, transport, Loki query delay and clock uncertainty.
variables.K_bound: Proven maximum stop-trigger-to-last-request-admission delay across the owned tree, including TERM grace, KILL and OS scheduling.

outstanding_bound.required_proof: A finite bound requires enforceable request admission/concurrency/rate and delivery/cancellation bounds for every native hidden path, or an upstream pre-admission token reservation mechanism that bounds all unreported requests even during telemetry outage. Post-response api_request events alone provide neither. Keep every unresolved value null; one coordinator/one child and a 5-second export interval do not prove them.
outstanding_bound.provider_charge: Include the FULL allowed charge of all active and admitted-but-unreported requests; killing a client does not undo a server-accepted request. Unknown charge cannot be set to zero. No subscription-percent or dollar cap is inferred.

cancellation.launch: Future supervisor uses subprocess.Popen(argv, start_new_session=True) and records PID, PGID, process start identity and descendant membership. Verify all experiment descendants remain in the owned group; escaping descendants block readiness. No global pkill, collector shutdown or signal to unrelated sessions.
cancellation.procedure: Latch stop and prevent further launches. Verify recorded ownership/start identity, signal os.killpg(pgid, SIGTERM), wait up to 5 seconds, then SIGKILL surviving owned group members. Wait/reap every owned process and independently verify the group is gone. Keep the observer/collector alive to drain and reconcile late events. A PID/ownership mismatch is an uncontained-stop error, never successful cleanup.
cancellation.qualification: Exercise ownership, escalation, descendant cleanup and observer liveness on offline disposable processes before sealing; retain monotonic durations. No cancellation was exercised in this repair.

token_budget.health: Query failure, missing/truncated page, counter/ID gap, lag above a sealed bound, observer failure, other Claude activity or failed cancellation immediately latches stop and incomplete. An independent supervisor watchdog must enforce observer liveness. An outage still needs pre-admission bounds; stop-on-outage alone cannot promise no overshoot.
token_budget.settlement: After owned exit, drain at least the qualified delivery bound and perform two full ledger reads one polling period apart plus offline ccusage reconciliation. Equality of snapshots is necessary but not proof of no lost events. Any unresolved request keeps the run incomplete and charged usage unknown.
token_budget.current_status: not_supported_as_a_proven_hard_cap: no measured lag, enforceable request bounds or cancellation receipt is available under this no-session repair. Token stop policy is specified; execution remains blocked.

whole_run_wall_cap.seal_rule: Before sealing, substitute independently qualified finite upper bounds and freeze the numeric whole_run_wall_cap_seconds at or above this formula. Each drain bound includes delivery wait, two complete ledger reads a polling period apart and ccusage reconciliation; readiness bound includes startup/preflight/inter-attempt orchestration outside attempts. Do not assume overlap with washouts. A 7200-second attempt cap cannot consume the washout/drain allowance. No arbitrary guessed drain bound or silent 259200-second fallback.

evidence.upstream_tests: None run or claimed here. The repository's test suites and builder vectors are local checks. Documentation/source review, structural validation and actual model operation are separate classes.
evidence.private_only: Original transcripts, prompts/responses, source captures and full command output stay in the operator's private evidence store. Public receipts use task/arm/repetition ordinals and content digests only: no native session/run/agent/message ids, personal paths, environment dumps, sign-ins, credentials or raw conversations.
evidence.discriminating_controls: oracle_framework defines hashed known-pass, known-fail, malformed and missing-output controls for all eight checks. They are synthetic definitions only until actual pinned Inspect scorer output is retained; full independent extraction-path controls and fixed-suite readiness are mandatory before sealing.
evidence.compaction_usage_audit: Use emitted request_ledger rows once; reconcile transcript/ccusage as cross-checks, never added totals. Qualify all applicable log attributes and Workflow ownership. Intermediate retries remain unobserved without traces/complete counter evidence, terminal errors always stop incomplete, and TTL weighting is unknown without per-request splits. An equal total does not establish coverage.

receipt_status_meaning.complete_no_change: Complete pilot with no candidate nomination; leaves incumbent A (unset: key absent, native default) unchanged.
receipt_status_meaning.complete_candidate_selected: Nomination for an independently preregistered confirmatory cohort only; no persistent host action. Setting B or C on the host requires that cohort to show non-inferior quality and the preregistered cost reduction, recorded.

sealing.hash_table: PREREGISTRATION.md: candidate SHA256 table is byte identity only, not a freeze or execution receipt
before_run: Confirm the amended host condition, incumbent A: a value-only readback shows the user-settings key absent (recorded 2026-09-27; the settings file mtime 23:21:57Z is not the removal instant). Launch A with env -u CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW, because sessions started before the removal keep 400000. Qualify the identical settings-source isolation, the must_be_absent_in_every_arm keys and the value-only arm_readback_gate for every arm before launch, with runtime coordinator/child evidence still required in each sealed attempt.

Prove every applicable required_log_attributes field through the active collector into Loki; resolve retry-observability and cache-write TTL instrument gaps by a dated source-backed amendment. Counter-less terminal errors stop incomplete. ID preservation alone cannot qualify launch.
Qualify finite drain/readiness bounds and freeze whole_run_wall_cap_seconds >= 271800 + 36*D + H, including 35 washouts and 36 drains.

Qualify native OTel request/child joins through the existing collector into Loki; retain measured reporting lag and proven outstanding-token reserve plus owned-process cancellation evidence. A documented export interval is not a bound; do not launch without qualification.
Materialize and verify all exact input inventories; retain pinned primary-source captures and tool/agent/MCP/carrier fingerprints

Materialize/hash all independent artifact adapters and output contracts, install Inspect 0.3.271 through its supported isolated path only in a separately authorized setup, and retain actual pinned scorer outputs for every known-pass, known-fail, malformed and missing-output control plus the fixed 97-module offline suite. Definitions alone are not readiness.
Record separate preregistration/seal commit and merge revision/time preceding all probes and arms; independently observe chronology
Append the dated sealing amendment with artifact SHA256 table, gate evidence and readiness; rehash before launch and each arm
sealing.amendment_rule: Preserve every prior amendment and seal table. Append date, reason, superseded rules/artifacts, whether results were observed, replacement hashes and merge/execution chronology. After any model observation, a changed workload, threshold, eligibility rule, instrument or budget requires a new cohort; retain the old incomplete/failed cohort. Never silently rewrite or retroactively recode eligibility.
sealing.adoption_rule: This pilot can nominate a candidate for an independently preregistered confirmatory cohort only. It supplies no authority for persistent host changes; the host incumbent A (key absent, native default) stays unchanged. Setting B or C on the host requires that confirmatory cohort to show non-inferior quality and the preregistered cost reduction, recorded. This DRAFT neither schedules, launches, freezes nor adopts an arm.

oracle_framework.execution: Offline Inspect scoring of native task outputs, not Inspect execution of Claude. Keep the existing Workflow launch unchanged except the window. No model-graded scorer or new provider requests.
oracle_framework.canonicalization: Strict JSON object parsing: reject duplicate keys, NaN/Infinity, extra/missing fields, bad types and absent independent source evidence. Canonical UTF-8 JSON uses sort_keys=true, separators=(comma,colon), ensure_ascii=true, allow_nan=false. Compare SHA256 hex of observed and independently derived target via Inspect match(location=exact,ignore_case=False,numeric=False), avoiding match whitespace normalization of literal JSON values. Invalid/missing evidence supplies a fixed non-hex invalid marker to the same scorer, yielding INCORRECT; infrastructure/source unavailability is unknown and blocks readiness.
oracle_framework.hashing: Control and contract sha256 covers the whole fixture/contract object with the canonical JSON serialization above, without a trailing newline. Digests bind definitions only, not successful execution.
